name: Monolithic Candle
original_name: モノリシックキャンドル
source:
Sanae can see the lifespan of others and spends hers making them happy.

Himesato City.
Sanae had just taken the college entrance exams,
fulfilling a promise to her dearly departed friend.
Staring out the bus window on her way home,
Sanae saw an old house.
Her heart raced suddenly, and she was compelled
to go there. Arriving in front of the house,
Sanae fell off the face of a cliff.

When she regained consciousness, she was in a bed.
The fabric smelled of mildew.

Everything changed when Sanae met Mikoto.

Their meeting would make her know life, death, and the world between---.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ171595.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
Sanae能够看见他人的寿命，并用自己的人生努力让他们幸福。

Himesato市。

Sanae刚刚参加完大学入学考试，

履行了与已故挚友的约定。

回家途中，她望着公交车窗外，

看见了一栋老宅。

她的心突然加速跳动，仿佛被什么牵引着，

不由自主地前往那里。来到宅前时，

Sanae从悬崖边坠了下去。

再次恢复意识时，她发现自己躺在床上，

被褥散发着霉味。

与Mikoto的相遇，改变了一切。

这场相遇，将让她认识生、死，以及两者之间的世界——
